title: Inside the basket: what the law requires
lines: Getting into a crane basket? Here's what must be in place.
The lift passed a certified inspection, with a valid report.
The operator is certified and checks the machine every morning.
Everyone in the basket is clipped to its anchor point, with the shortest possible lanyard.
With us, this happens every day, as a matter of course.
Ofek At Tal Cranes. Safety first.
